definitions: To provide information or a communication for someone who is not immediately available, often with the expectation that they will receive it later.
To record a spoken communication, typically on an answering machine or voicemail system, for a person who is unable to answer the phone.
examples: Please leave a message after the beep.
I had to leave a message because she wasn't home.
He left a message with the receptionist.
Don't forget to leave a message if I don't pick up.
